announced on Tuesday that it plans to invest up to $25M over three years to boost AI development and adoption.
Its AI research group, 'Layer 6,' will collaborate with Cohere
to develop practical AI applications across the bank.
The focus will be on improving productivity, decision-making, and client experiences, along with knowledge management and AI security.
Importantly, Cohere’s enterprise AI models and technical expertise will be combined with Layer 6’s research capabilities and understanding of TD's business.
The initiative is part of the company's broader $150B five-year investment commitment aimed at supporting growth and innovation across Canada.

title: TD Bank teams up with Cohere for up to $25M AI push
